fixture_text: The institution announces its annual meetings, governance agenda, plenary sessions and member-country discussions. Registration information and meeting logistics are provided for delegates.

The annual financial report summarizes capital adequacy, treasury operations, administrative expenditure and audited institutional accounts. The document reports aggregate balance-sheet information only.
This governance policy describes ethics, disclosure, records retention, staff responsibilities and internal review procedures. It does not announce a works package or a tender.
A recruitment notice seeks an internal audit specialist. The notice lists qualifications, employment duties, application instructions and the closing date for candidates.
